ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent investigative system built on TigerGraph that iteratively queries graph neighborhoods and vector embeddings to trace complex financial fraud networks.
ideas.problem_statement: TigerGraph Agentic GraphRAG Hackathon: Building an agentic system that autonomously investigates complex questions using graph, vector, and document evidence by breaking down queries and spotting gaps.
ideas.title: GraphTrace-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine hard engineering by combining iterative LangGraph loops with TigerGraph GSQL graph traversal, satisfying the core thesis of when agentic approaches outperform simple RAG.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent supply chain risk analysis system that ingests unstructured PDF contracts and maps multi-tier supplier dependency graphs on TigerGraph to answer cascading failure impact queries.
ideas.problem_statement: TigerGraph Agentic GraphRAG Hackathon: Building an agentic system that autonomously investigates complex questions using graph, vector, and document evidence by breaking down queries and spotting gaps.
ideas.title: SupplyGraph-Autonomous
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working live demo showing multi-turn agentic reasoning over complex enterprise data structures, which appeals strongly to technical judges looking for practical utility.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous biomedical research agent that deconstructs complex drug-target-pathway questions, queries TigerGraph biomedical knowledge graphs, and retrieves supporting literature chunks recursively.
ideas.problem_statement: TigerGraph Agentic GraphRAG Hackathon: Building an agentic system that autonomously investigates complex questions using graph, vector, and document evidence by breaking down queries and spotting gaps.
ideas.title: BioGraph-Query
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a domain where simple RAG categorically fails due to multi-hop dependency requirements, proving the exact value proposition requested by the hackathon organizers.

ideas.pitch: An agentic compliance checking engine that breaks down regulatory queries, traverses corporate hierarchy and policy rule graphs in TigerGraph, and verifies evidence gaps across dense document stores.
ideas.problem_statement: TigerGraph Agentic GraphRAG Hackathon: Building an agentic system that autonomously investigates complex questions using graph, vector, and document evidence by breaking down queries and spotting gaps.
ideas.title: PolicyGraph-Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an explicit gap-evaluation loop where the agent self-critiques its retrieved evidence before final answer synthesis, directly aligning with advanced metacognition benchmarks.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous litigation discovery agent that parses legal precedents, constructs citation and entity graphs in TigerGraph, and iteratively investigates weak legal arguments through multi-step retrieval.

ideas.title: LegalGraph-Navigator
